title: Free-Transform warp dropped for symbol-internal shapes (sprite.ts doesn't bake warp; only scene timeline does)
description: FIXED (see commit). Root cause: sprite.ts (DefineSprite builder) ignored obj.warp on its own shape-encode pre-pass (~338, shiftShapePaths) and emitted affine objTransform in both sprite-internal PlaceObject2 emit branches (~705 first-placement, ~936 move) — so a Free-Transform Distort/Envelope warp on a shape inside a movieclip/graphic symbol was dropped from the published DefineShape4 (stage/SWF divergence), same defect class as 1228/1230 but on the sprite path. FIX: when obj.warp is set, bake it via the shared bakeWarpIntoShape (reuses engine/warp.ts; origin-relative geometry) with shapeNormOrigin=(0,0) so the residual PlaceObject2 carries (x,y); and gate the sprite-internal objTransform to identity for warped shapes (displayObj.type==='shape' && !displayObj.warp) in both emit branches, mirroring 1230's frames.ts fix. Handles ShapeDisplayObject and DrawingObject inside symbols. REGRESSION TEST: packages/swf/src/__tests__/warp-sprite-bake.test.ts (compiles a real movieclip-symbol doc via compileDocument; decodes the DefineShape4 hoisted above the DefineSprite AND the sprite-internal PlaceObject2 matrix from our own SWF; distort baked to xMax=5000/yMax=4000 twips not pristine 1000..3000, translate-only PO2, warp+scale/rotation un-doubled, pure-affine/un-warped symbol cases unchanged). Verified the 3 warp-baking assertions FAIL on pre-fix sprite.ts and PASS after. Results: @flash/swf 1403/1403 pass; @flash/core 5295 pass with only the pre-existing fixtures/flash8-empty.fla ENOENT failures (task-1207 class, fixture absent in worktree); typecheck/build green.
